name: Ryouki 2 ~Ayashiku Ugomeku Inbou no Enbukyoku~
original_name: 凌姫II～妖しく蠢く淫謀の円舞曲～
source:
The emperor and empress of the revered Phoenicia Empire fell ill. Shortly after, the empress passed away, and the emperor's condition teetered between life and death. Rumors spread that the emperor's symptoms might be due to a curse, leading to a witch hunt within and outside the palace. Concerned about the situation, princesses Leticia and Iria organized an imperial guard to quell the unrest. Amidst this, a low-ranking knight named Leon, believing he has royal blood, sought to exploit the chaos to eliminate rival royals.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ004142.html/?unique_op=af]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
备受尊崇的腓尼基帝国中，皇帝与皇后双双病倒。不久后，皇后驾崩，皇帝的病情也在生死之间徘徊。传言称皇帝的症状可能源自诅咒，宫廷内外由此掀起猎巫行动。公主蕾蒂西亚与伊莉娅忧心局势，组织皇家卫队平息动乱。与此同时，一名相信自己拥有王室血统的低阶骑士雷昂，企图利用混乱铲除其他王族竞争者。
